title: rumohra hasseltii
intro: Rumohra hasseltii, commonly known as Lady Palm or Ruffled Fan Palm, is a species of flowering plant in the family Polypodiaceae, native to Southeast Asia. The plant is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory issues, and acting as a natural antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Rumohra hasseltii include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of Rumohra hasseltii are responsible for its medicinal properties, making it a popular ingredient in traditional medicine.
